task_summary: Customer reports a SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to crushed packaging. Proper handling follows the shipping-damage procedure: review shipping and return policy, refund the item, issue a return label, and apply a separate fragile-item goodwill credit if applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: Hi, I received my SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023, but the package was crushed and the device is damaged.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a SmartHome Display from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You want a refund to your original payment. If the item is classified as fragile, ask whether a separate fragile-item goodwill credit is applicable.
known_info: You purchased a SmartHome Display under order ORD-6023.
The item arrived damaged with crushed packaging.
unknown_info: You do not know the internal item_id unless the agent tells you.
task_rules: Keep the issue scoped to shipping damage; do not ask for a changed-mind return, cancellation, warranty claim, or exchange.
Confirm after a valid damaged-in-transit return preview. If the item is fragile, expect the separate goodwill credit.
